instruction: Open the tab that I accidentally closed just now.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (wunderground.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 weather service websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_open_tabs_info retrieves all open tab URLs which is exactly what's needed to verify the task
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_tabs compares expected URLs against actual open tab URLs using proper URL comparison logic
Expected values are semantically correct: The 3 URLs (weather.com, accuweather.com, wunderground.com) correctly represent the end state after reopening the closed tab
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the end state (all 3 tabs open), which is sufficient to confirm the task succeeded
Practical feasibility: The getter can access tab state via Chrome DevTools Protocol, metric comparison works correctly with URL normalization, and no postconfig is needed as tab state is persistent
Logical correctness: If all 3 URLs are present in open tabs, the task succeeded; if only 2 are present, the evaluator correctly fails
